Cost: 50eb

Translate text in any language to your native one. Requires an Action to scan and translate a single sign or a few words. Takes 1 minute (20 rounds) of scanning to translate an entire page of text. Provides the literal meaning of the text and struggles with highly technical information.

Foundry notes:

  • An app runs on a Neuroport or an Agent and does nothing without one (see the House Rules journal). Keep it in the inventory while the character has either.
  • Translation is not automated.

From Bontari Homebrew Cyberpunk Items by Bontari (Apps).
